title: Zero fanout at the circuit boundary
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $gs$ be a list of Boolean gates in which every gate at position $i$ reads only vertices with index less than $n+i$. If $n+|gs|\le v+1$, then the fanout of vertex $v$ within $gs$ is zero.
hypotheses_covered: The gate list satisfies the stated acyclicity condition
